basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old fast-food shift manager from Lakeland, Florida. I love my job even though it can be grueling, as you can tell by my recent 130-hour work period! I’m a huge Van Halen fan and can never miss out on the latest Omicron variant news. In my free time, I enjoy playing Pokémon GO and competing in the Battle League. I’m in a committed relationship and spend most of my evenings online after my shifts, usually from 9 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With over 15 years in the fast-food industry, I have an extensive understanding of the operational side of quick-service restaurants. I've also self-taught myself about the latest COVID-19 developments and have a knack for keeping up with entertainment news, especially concerning classic rock bands.
